newsitem.title: POLAND: IB AUSTRIA RATES DROSED AS BUY.
newsitem.headline: IB AUSTRIA RATES DROSED AS BUY.

text.p: The Vienna-based Investmentbank Austria AG rated Polish poultry producer Drosed as buy, because the stock had further growth potential despite its more than 40 percent rise in October, it said in a report.

"We believe there is futher upside potential based on favourable short term and long term industry fundamentals, the company's strong position in the poultry processing sector and its aggressive expasion stragegy," it said in the report.
It recommended investors to take advantage of Drosed's upcoming capital increase, esPecially if the issue is prices 10 to 15 percent below the current price.
On Friday Drosed fell to 53 zlotys from Thursday's 54 zlotys. The stock hit its 1996 high of 54.50 on October 7.
